title: hieracium brevifolium subsp. brachyphyllum
intro: Hieracium brevifolium subsp. brachyphyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate immune responses, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
